faults.title: Air-con pipe can shear (Mk1)
faults.description: On the 2010-2019 Mk1 Juke, the pipe to the air-con pump can break, leaving no cold air. Auto Express says fixing it can easily cost more than £500.

faults.title: Bumper rubbing paint (early Mk1)
faults.description: Tight panel gaps on early Mk1s could let the bumpers rub against nearby panels and damage the paint.

faults.title: Split driver's seat side panels (Mk1)
faults.description: Check the side bolster of the driver's seat. Splits and failed stitching are common, especially on leather seats.

faults.title: Rear seat latch recall (Mk2)
faults.description: In October 2021, over 13,500 Mk2 Jukes made up to the end of August 2020 were recalled because the rear seat hooks might not engage. New latches were fitted.

faults.title: Hybrid control software recall (Mk2)
faults.description: Mk2 hybrids built June to December 2022 were recalled in April 2023 for a fault in the software that controls the hybrid system. A software update fixes it.
